other_conditions: The applicant must not be a defaulter or insolvent of any nationalized bank, financial institution, or cooperative bank.
The applicant must not be receiving assistance under any other government entrepreneur or self‑employment scheme.
The applicant is eligible for assistance under this scheme only once.
The enterprise must be established within the limits of Madhya Pradesh.
The scheme is intended for the industry or service business sector.
benefits_summary: Provides margin money assistance up to ₹15,000 (50% of project cost, with a maximum project cost of ₹50,000), a 6‑month moratorium, and loan repayment over 5 years.
